title: Import a folder of scans
description: The everyday job: point ScanFinder at the folder your scanner saves into and let it read, identify and file. Eight documents: three from a taught supplier, five from a new one. The folder is chosen over DevTools (eval_js) instead of the native picker so the presenter's folder tree never appears.

steps.narration: Once ScanFinder knows your suppliers, importing is the everyday job: point it at the folder your scanner saves into, and let it work.
steps.caption: Import: point it at your scans folder

steps.narration: Click Import in the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Import

steps.narration: Click the folder box and choose the folder that holds your scans — the usual Windows folder picker opens. ScanFinder reads PDFs and images, and it never deletes the originals: each one is moved into a Processed folder alongside once it's been brought in.
steps.caption: 2. Choose the folder your scanner saves into

steps.js: (async () => { const folder = "{{SCANS_BATCH_JS}}"; selectedFolder = folder; const parts = folder.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/'); folderDisplay.textContent = parts.length > 3 ? '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/') : folder; folderDisplay.title = folder; folderDisplay.classList.add('set'); folderBox.classList.remove('cue'); btnRun.disabled = false; const d = document.getElementById('dash-folder'); if (d) { d.textContent = folder; d.classList.add('set'); } await showFolderPreview(folder); return folder; })()
steps.narration: We've chosen a Batch folder holding eight documents: three more from Copperfield Electrical, which it was taught earlier, and five from Ironbridge Fabrication, a supplier it has never seen. It lists what it found so you can check it's the right folder.
steps.caption: It lists the documents it found

steps.narration: For each page it straightens the scan, reads the text, works out who sent it, the date and the reference, and checks them against what it has learned.
steps.caption: Reading each page…

steps.narration: Documents it is sure about are filed straight into your output folder, into a folder for the company, the year and the month. Anything it isn't sure about — a supplier it hasn't met, a smudged date — waits in Review for a quick check.
steps.caption: Sure → filed · unsure → Review

steps.narration: A batch like this takes about a minute. Bigger batches carry on in the background while you get on with something else.
steps.caption: Bigger batches run in the background

steps.narration: When it finishes, the counters show how many were filed and how many need a look, and Review your documents takes you straight to those.
steps.caption: Filed vs needs a look → Review your documents

steps.narration: That's importing. Next: what to do in Review.
steps.caption: Next: Review
